issues.description: The problem statement and UML require a constructor that initializes five attributes in the order (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The template's Lecture constructor only declares three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents), which prevents students from implementing the constructor as specified. The solution uses a five-parameter constructor matching the UML, so the template is structurally inconsistent with the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Lecture constructor signature to include all five parameters in the order specified by the UML: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Initialize the corresponding attributes in the constructor body so students can implement the class exactly as described.
